Jennifer Aniston still earns $20 million yearly from Friends
story.summary: Jennifer Aniston reportedly continues to earn $20 million annually from Friends, more than 20 years after the sitcom ended. The show’s six stars initially earned $22,500 per episode before collective negotiations pushed their salaries to $1 million in the final seasons. A groundbreaking profit-sharing deal also helped the cast benefit from the sitcom’s enduring popularity and continued revenue.

story.title: Tom Cruise to be honored with American Film Institute award
story.summary: Actor Tom Cruise is set to receive the American Film Institute's Life Achievement Award in April. This award has been given annually since 1973 to individuals who have made significant contributions to film. Previous recipients include notable figures like Bette Davis and Tom Hanks, among others. Cruise has been recognized for his commitment to cinema and his belief in its unifying power.
